passportSession.name: passport_session
passportSession.description: Proposed gateway cookie name, not an assertion about existing HQ cookies. Secure HttpOnly session integrated with existing identity provider.

csrfToken.description: Session-bound token; keep only in memory. Never log.

CaptureLocation.description: captured requires coordinates; denied/unavailable require position null; manual requires declaredPlace and must follow server site policy. Capture is evidence, never authoritative Atlas state.

CheckIn.description: Operator and accepted time are server-derived. HQ resolves and snapshots Atlas region/observation; client cannot set them. Evidence must be ready, owned, private and asset-scoped. Null meter/signature is allowed only when the server asset profile does not require it.

CheckOut.description: Business validation includes monotonic meter, compatible attachment assignment, critical defect policy and atomic service activity/outbox writes.

ActivityInput.description: Server discriminates by kind: fuel requires fuel only; damage/service_request requires defect only; attachment_change requires attachmentChange only; photo requires nonempty evidenceIds and no other payload. Enforce after schema validation.

PublicServiceSummary.description: Illustrative future published summary only; adapt existing public projection. No new public endpoint or automatic publication is proposed.
